context.body: Prayer first appears within danger, promise, judgment, confession, and one person speaking for another. The bounded source is Numbers 21:4–9.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: The people confess and ask Moses to pray.
observations.label: Confession leads to intercession and a commanded sign: action

observations.body: his intercession precedes the commanded bronze serpent.
observations.label: Confession leads to intercession and a commanded sign: response

payload.posture: Read Numbers 21:4–9 as calling, fear, and intercession evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: Moses prays after confession, yet the response is not immediate removal of the serpents but a commanded means of looking and living.
payload.title: Confession leads to intercession and a commanded sign
